_meta.source: ls.* fields: same as depleting.json, synthesised by scaling kerbalism-fixture-baseline-crp.json (food/water down to ~25%, drain faster, scrubber broken). greenhouse.* fields: Kerbalism source at the pinned kerbalism-src checkout, src/Kerbalism/Modules/Greenhouse.cs (`Greenhouse.Data` + `SimulateGreenhouse`'s lighting gate: `bool lighting = natural + artificial >= g.light_tolerance;`) and GameData/KerbalismConfig/Profiles/Default.cfg's `kerbalism-greenhouse` part config (same constants as greenhouse-growing.json). Issue text is the real localization string #KERBALISM_Greenhouse_issue1 = 'insufficient lighting' (GameData/Kerbalism/Localization/en-us.cfg). CORRECTED (prior pass): removed the fabricated 'growth'/'timeToHarvestSec' fields, see greenhouse-growing.json's _meta for the full explanation (no growth/harvest-countdown concept exists anywhere in Kerbalism; Food is a continuous ResourceRecipe output, gated on/off by natural+artificial < light_tolerance with no partial-credit accumulator). `greenhouse.lampEcDrawPerSec` here is the derived actual draw `ec_rate * (artificial / light_tolerance)` from SimulateGreenhouse's recipe construction (2.5 * (120/400) = 0.75), not the raw ec_rate config constant (see greenhouse.ecRateMaxPerSec, unchanged from config). Note `active: true` even though the greenhouse is blocked, `active` is only the player's own on/off toggle, not whether it is currently producing; the widget's Growing/Blocked/Off badge derives state from `active` + `issue` together, never from `active` alone. FIXED (this pass): `greenhouse.foodRatePerSec` was carrying the same 0.0001148431 nominal rate as the growing fixture even though this scenario is lighting-gated off, real Kerbalism zeroes the ResourceRecipe entirely while `natural + artificial < light_tolerance` (40 + 120 = 160 < 400 here), so a blocked greenhouse produces nothing; corrected to 0. WIRED (this pass): `kerbalism.lifesupport.greenhouses` is now a real field on the wire contract (`KerbalismLifeSupport.Greenhouses` in mod/Sitrep.Contract/KerbalismPayloads.cs) and the widget renders it through the new `life-support.sections` augment slot (`LifeSupportSystems/GreenhouseSection.tsx`), fed here via the `_stream` block below, same reasoning as greenhouse-growing.json's _meta. STILL NOT wired: `GonogoKerbalismUplink`'s capture pipeline does not populate `greenhouses` yet; that reflection work is separate, out of scope for this pass. Until it lands, `greenhouses` arrives as `undefined` in production and the section renders nothing.
